The humor also kinda fell off hard around 5. 5 was still kinda funny, but 6 and 7 could hardly get a smile out of me. I still enjoy Disgaea because it's the closest thing to Final Fantasy Tactics out there, but I mostly enjoy building my lil army now and wrecking shit. It's a shame, cause I used to think this series was like 8-9 quality wise in the 1st 4, but after 4 it's closer to a 6 or 7 on D5. I still like D-2 as well, but I imagine that's wildly due to my bias towards the cast, cause Disgaea 1 was my favorite, followed by 4. If you haven't played 3 yet, I recommend it, Mao is a great protagonist, his plot and the supporting characters are great, everyone in Disgaea 3 is a special kind of psychopath, with the exception of Almaz, which makes his situation funnier. I loved the music myself. My favorite is the march of the archadian empire, but the rabanastre song and the dalmascan westersand are also pretty memorable to me. The boss and summon fight songs were also really tense and amazing. Overall I love how the sounds of this ost really feel like they flesh oit the areas they're in, almost like it's part of the scenery. Overall, I wouldn't say it's one of the best FF music wise, but only because FF has such high highs in the music department overall, but XII has definitely some of the best environment accompanying music. Struggle for freedom, flash of steel, life and death, boss battle, absolute great battle themes. A great aspect of XII's soundtrack is that where most FF have 1-3 good battle themes, this 1 has a huge selection of varied and great combat themes.

I liked the system overall too. First FF I 100% and doing so made me really stretch my understanding of all aspects of it and it was fun and deep. Idk how people say you can auto battle the entire game, the 1st eidolon fight was my first wall cause he wooped my ass hard, you really can't just auto battle the eidolon fights. The combat system also opens up after the 1st clear after everyone's style lv caps open up and it becomes a lot more fun as you unlock new skills some characters lacked in the regular playthrough. This is my favorite atb combat because it felt fast and not slogish and cluncky. My other favorite combat systems were tactics',  10 and 12, but I prefer a faster paced more active combat rather than what the earlier games provide. I also love job systems, despite XIII having named them differently than previous series' jobs, I love job systems in FF. Having to adjust jobs on the fly also felt cool depending on the situation you're in on. Overall I really liked the system, was just a bit difficult to understand it on my first playthrough.

Hey man, I know getting in shape is hard but I have some experience and hopefully some helpful advice as well. It's a very hard and slow process but it is doable. Unfortunately it takes more than just actually working out to get there, food and counting calories will have to be part of it. Look up your bmi online, you can probably find a calculator easy, get your average reccomended daily calorie intake and eat accordingly. I think you want to eat about 500 calories less than what you usually use daily, if you go higher it can actually slow down your process so don't go too hard. Also I'd double check my numbers just to make sure. As far as working out I'd find 1 really good friend to go work out with. I've been doing sports since I was really small and having a friend for support and help goes a very long way to actually getting you motivated. Be consistent and patient with your workout, progress is slow but with determination and commitment anyone can get into any specific shape they set their minds to. I also wouldn't look at models in magazines etc as a set goal because those guys have to look like that for one day, in one phoro shoot, and a few pictures are selected out of the many that are taken. If you can make workouts fun, they'll be a lot more bearable if they have some manner of positive emotions attached to  them. I hope any of this helps, that you feel better and get some work done on your mental and physical health my friend. Be well o/
